name: SkillAegis — Cyber-exercise scenarios (CEXF)
description: Imports cyber-exercise scenarios from SkillAegis (https://github.com/SkillAegis — CIRCL / MISP ecosystem), a platform to design, run and monitor training exercises. Scenarios are authored by the SkillAegis-Editor in the Common Exercise Format (CEXF, JSON) and run/tracked live by the SkillAegis-Dashboard (participants, injects, scores). This connector parses a CEXF scenario (or a directory / JSON list) and maps each exercise into XORCISM's Crisis Management / Tabletop-Exercise library: the exercise becomes a CRISISSCENARIO (a reusable scenario template — name, description, objectives, severity from the exercise level, ATT&CK tags, author, duration), and each inject (task), ordered by the scenario's inject_flow, becomes an EXERCISEINJECT (title, description, type = the inject action/target-tool, expected outcome). The imported scenario can then be launched as a tabletop exercise at /crisis-management. Idempotent by the CEXF exercise UUID. Python stdlib only; worker-safe (no DB, no network).

parameters.name: file
parameters.help: Path on the worker to a SkillAegis CEXF scenario (.json), a directory of scenarios, or a JSON list/export. Get scenarios from the SkillAegis-Editor or the SkillAegis/scenarios repo.
